items.title: Check emergency medical care information for Kumamoto City
items.summary: Check Kumamoto City's information about emergency medical care, medical services available on holidays and at night, and medical consultation services.
items.emergency_note: If the situation is clearly an emergency or life-threatening, call 119. Check the linked official destination directly for the latest available medical facilities, consultation hours, and other details.
